subject: words
title: Add an ending
about: Words with the endings -s, -es, -ing and -ed, which NC RF.1.4.f names. The -ed ending has three sounds (t in jumped, d in filled, ed in planted); CKLA teaches -ed in Unit 4 and plurals plus doubling the last letter before -ing or -ed (running) in Unit 5.
tip: Cover the ending with a finger, read the base word, then uncover and add the ending.

cards.note: The ending s says /s/ here: one cup, many cups.
The ending s says /z/ here: one hen, many hens.
